Café Gerbeaud, Budapest

One storey baroque building. Built in 1698. End of the 18th century facade. 14th century architectural elements. On its groundfloor Russwurm Pastry shop with Neo-Classical enterior around 1830. Part of the Budapest World Heritage protected architectural ensembles - 7 Szentháromság Street = 28 Tárnok = 21 Úri Street, Várnegyed neighborhood, District I of Budapest.
